title: Governed Refund/Replacement Remedies and Obligation Resolution
scope: remedy creation resolves a canonical purchase obligation and recorded fulfillment exception
remedy creation and completion require bounded authority with quantity context
refund/replacement/credit quantity cannot exceed the source exception or shared unresolved obligation position
remedy completion is evidence-backed and duplicate completion fails closed
replacement through substitution cannot bypass equivalence, recomputation and consent requirements
performed and remedied quantity share one obligation-resolution conservation boundary
credit remains explicitly classified as non-stored-value unless separately classified and authorized

invariants.INV-001: PARTIAL_GREEN strengthened: consequential remedy actions require AuthorityEvaluator approval.
invariants.INV-020: PARTIAL_GREEN strengthened: performance plus remedy cannot exceed the original obligation quantity.
invariants.INV-021: PARTIAL_GREEN strengthened: replacement/substitution retains equivalence, consent and economic recomputation requirements.
invariants.INV-024: PARTIAL_GREEN strengthened: completion is additive evidence; prior fulfillment/exception history is not rewritten.
invariants.INV-027: PARTIAL_GREEN strengthened: duplicate remedy completion cannot duplicate economic resolution.
invariants.INV-030: No promotion. SW1 composition reuses SW0 remedy/resolution semantics and does not create new stored-value or automatic-settlement meaning.
